notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI); Provider push sends provider events to WEBHOOK (Flask); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).

CHAT (FastAPI) reads + writes PostgreSQL and makes API calls to LLM providers; INTERACTION (Flask) reads + writes PostgreSQL, enqueues SQS tasks, starts Temporal workflows and makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs; WEBHOOK (Flask) reads PostgreSQL.
Temporal workflows read PostgreSQL.

AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers, SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers and OUTREACH · WORKFLOWSCHEDULER workers long-poll SQS; AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers also read + write PostgreSQL; SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers also read + write PostgreSQL and make API calls to CRM + workspace APIs; OUTREACH · WORKFLOWSCHEDULER workers also read PostgreSQL; and also SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks.
